summary: Connect the numbers and find each puzzle's unique solution.
description:
Get ready to put your logic skills to the test with Rikudo - the addictive number placement puzzle game with a visual and intuitive twist!

Connect the numbers and discover each puzzle's unique solution on a honeycomb grid with hexagonal cells. With plenty of puzzles of various sizes and levels, an evil mode to spice it up, and some puzzles in action mode, there are hours of fun and brain training ahead!

But that's not all - Rikudo also offers leaderboards and achievements to challenge your friends, a pepper mode to crank up the difficulty on smaller puzzles, and hints to learn the most advanced solving techniques.

With an animated tutorial to get you started, Rikudo is easy to understand but can be challenging to master. And with cloud synchronization across devices available with Google Play Games, you can play anytime, anywhere, even offline!

Download Rikudo now and get ready to immerse yourself in a world of addictive number puzzles - ad-free for any in-app purchase! Produced by an independent developer, Rikudo is the perfect game for anyone looking to put their brainpower to the test.
